narratives.Description: Deliver Module 6 as a self-directed lesson that turns horizontal activity lists into small end-to-end outcomes with observable evidence. This story is independently buildable because it is command-free and owns its lesson, exercise, explained solution, source trace, navigation, and focused content checks.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Revalidate the strategy, specification, proposed-scope, work-shaping, and decomposition claims against the pinned Directive 0.112.0 source, then author curriculum/modules/06-creating-well-shaped-work.md and solutions/module-06-creating-well-shaped-work.md with fictional planning exercises and outcome-mapped evidence.
2. Update the exact learner navigation and reference files, add scripts/verify-module-6.mjs plus negative unit tests, and run the focused npm checks and xBRIEF conformance check before the aggregate gate.
narratives.UserStory: As a 3Ci engineer learning Directive, I want to reshape horizontal plans into demonstrable vertical slices, so that I can propose work with observable outcomes and recognize when an epic needs decomposition.
narratives.Traces: Parent training.modules6-8.shaping, PROJECT-DEFINITION LearningGoals: work shaping and observable acceptance, PROJECT-DEFINITION CourseShape and SourceOfTruth contracts

narrative.Acceptance: The source record validates every version-sensitive Module 6 claim against Directive 0.112.0 and records any prose-versus-runtime disagreement without inventing newer behavior.

items.title: Author the Module 6 lesson and vertical-slice exercise

narrative.Acceptance: Given a fictional horizontal component plan, the learner creates one end-to-end slice whose artifact, user-visible outcome, exclusions, and literal inspection are recorded.

items.title: Trace an idea into proposed scope

narrative.Acceptance: Given a fictional idea, the learner records a bounded strategy choice, a testable specification statement, and a proposed-scope artifact without treating that proposal as implementation authority.

items.title: Teach epic recognition and ordered decomposition

narrative.Acceptance: Given an epic-sized scenario, the learner creates an ordered set of independently verifiable slices and records dependency and boundary rationale for every slice.

items.title: Add the explained solution and focused verifier

narrative.Acceptance: Focused negative tests reject missing outcome IDs, required learning sections, local links, exact Directive 0.112.0 claims, and Module 7's still-planned status; the explained solution records the expected evidence.

expected_outputs: Module 6 lesson and solution satisfy the self-directed content contract
Negative verifier tests reject missing outcomes, broken links, stale readiness, and unsupported version claims
